title: Design: Modern invoice billed to someone else prints the Service For band
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A and customer B with an asset that has a unit, year, make and model (for example Unit 854, 2024 INTERNATIONAL CV515).
  • Have a new work order for this test for customer B on that asset, billed to customer A, invoiced after the Bill To release.
  • Set the document design to modern (Settings, invoice and estimate design).
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p4-02-after-modern.png, bt-p4-01-before-modern.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Click the print icon on the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Finance tab shows the invoice.

Step 2:

  • Directly under the ADDRESSES box (Bill To | Remit payment to) a full-width band with a light grey fill, thin grey border and rounded corners reads "SERVICE FOR" (small bold capitals), then customer B's name in bold, then " · Unit <unit> · <year> <make> <model>".
  • The Bill To block names customer A with its address and phone.
  • The asset row and everything below move down by the band's height.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To), story SV-12310 (Story 8, "Service For" band on invoices and estimates)

  • S8-R1: “A full-width band prints directly under the address row, reading "SERVICE FOR", then the customer's name in bold.”
  • S8-R2: “On a work order with an asset, the band adds "Unit [unit]" and "[year] [make] [model]", separated by " · ".”
  • S8-R5: “The band has a light grey fill and a thin grey border so it reads in black and white.”
  • S8-R7: “The band leaves the address row free for a future Ship To block.”
  • S7-R1: “The invoice's Bill To block prints the Bill To's name, address and phone, saved on the invoice when it is created.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "4 Service For band on invoices and estimates", pictures "Modern" (This build), "Modern" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).
